encoding: Bare single-call filesystem probe. os.path.exists is NOT in the harvested op-surface (boolean/compare/arith/bit/unary/conditional) and there is no surrounding boolean structure to solve (unlike BenchmarkProblems.py:657 where exists is one operand of an Or/Not). The maximal sound encoding is a single uninterpreted boolean e = os.path.exists(sourceDir), unconstrained by the seeded sourceDir string domain. Z3 run in-container confirms both polarities are trivially sat: TRUE check sat with model [os_path_exists_sourceDir = True]; FALSE check sat with model [os_path_exists_sourceDir = False]. Because the result is a function of (string value, live filesystem state) rather than the string value alone, the predicate is not statically decidable from inputs in the op-surface.
empirical_runtime_evidence: In-container: same string value /tmp/<tmpdir>/source returns os.path.exists == False before os.makedirs and == True after. Identical input value, opposite result => the predicate depends on external filesystem state, not just sourceDir.

true_examples.precondition: directory exists on disk (created by makedirs upstream before writeClientConfigIni); assert passes and writeClientConfigIni proceeds

false_examples.precondition: no such directory on disk; assert raises AssertionError sourceDir=/nonexistent/path/source does not exist

assumptions: os.path.exists(sourceDir) is a filesystem syscall, abstracted to a free boolean per the seeded domain. There is no other operand or operator in the predicate, so nothing is statically solvable: truth is entirely determined by the live filesystem at call time.
sourceDir is computed upstream from CLI OutputPath + benchmark/client config (e.g. OutputPath/1_ClientParameters/source). The assert is a defensive guard, not a value-driven branch.
runtime_note: Assert at function entry of writeClientConfigIni. TRUE-witness: create sourceDir via os.makedirs then call -> assert passes. FALSE-witness: pass a non-existent path -> AssertionError. Both witnesses are by VALUE (not solver-proven) because the predicate is an external FS probe.

crosshair.caveat: No pure helper extractable: the sole operation is an impure os.path.exists side-channel into the filesystem.
